child_briefs.title: GHEI Agy Slot Locking and Pool Isolation
child_briefs.scope: Secure slot allocation under file lock with atomic creation, PID writing, and start-time validation to prevent recycled PID reuse or stale locks from causing a DoS. Disable the home fallback (`allow_home_fallback: false`).
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not bind-mount X11 displays, handle Xvfb setup, or configure media/video recording.
child_briefs.deliverables: File-lock slot allocation implementation in `harness/agy_pool.py` with PID validation and disabled home fallback.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes allocate_slot(busy, size: int) -> int | None

child_briefs.title: GHEI Boundary Deduplicator and Aligner
child_briefs.scope: Align patch indentation to target prefix indentation level before running deduplication. Implement AST-based method/class identifier matching and decorator signature parsing (e.g. `@register_state`) with fallback error recovery to prevent false pops and indent collapses.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement adaptive sliding retry windows or comment injection checks.
child_briefs.deliverables: AST-based boundary aligner, deduplicator, and decorator parser in `harness/boundary_smoothing.py`.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes align_and_deduplicate_patches(source: str, patch: str) -> str

child_briefs.title: GHEI Boundary Sliding Retry
child_briefs.scope: Implement adaptive sliding retry windows ($± \Delta$ lines) to resolve compile/syntax errors near edit boundaries, protected by semantic anchor verification to block comment injections and formatting false positives.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement base indentation alignment or AST method parsing.
child_briefs.deliverables: Sliding window edit retry and semantic anchor verification in `harness/boundary_smoothing.py`.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes apply_with_sliding_retry(source: str, patch: str, delta: int) -> str

child_briefs.title: GHEI Contact Sheet Generation
child_briefs.scope: Transcode captured video into a single 3x3 tiled contact sheet to minimize multimodal token footprint, ensuring commas in FFmpeg filter lists are not backslash-escaped, and falling back to a static black warning frame on 0-frame or short video (<9s) edge cases.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not run screencast loops or start framebuffers.
child_briefs.deliverables: Contact sheet generator with unescaped FFmpeg filter lists and static black frame fallback.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes generate_contact_sheet(video_path: str, output_image_path: str) -> None

child_briefs.title: GHEI Crash Resilient Screencasting
child_briefs.scope: Capture async video screencasts using fragmented MP4 (`fMP4`) format and packet flushing. Resolve dynamic display resolution bounds via `xdpyinfo` check with fallback to 1280x1024 to avoid FFmpeg startup crash.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not start Xvfb server, run HMAC sweeper, or compile tiled images.
child_briefs.deliverables: Crash-resilient video recorder using fMP4 and dynamic resolution helper.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes start_screencast(display: str, output_path: str) -> subprocess.Popen

child_briefs.title: GHEI Diffusion Gemma Client
child_briefs.scope: Set up local vLLM serving parameters for DiffusionGemma-26B-it on GPU0 (RTX 3090) with automatic prefix caching (APC) to reduce prefill latencies and implement the client interface wrapper (`synthesize_inpaint_with_retries`).
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement boundary deduplication, alignment, or sliding window retries.
child_briefs.deliverables: Local vLLM serving configurations and the client wrapper `synthesize_inpaint_with_retries`.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes synthesize_inpaint_with_retries(prompt: str, image_path: str, mask_path: str, **kwargs) -> str

child_briefs.title: GHEI E2E Capstone and Enforce Knob
child_briefs.scope: Verify the full GHEI loop end-to-end and configure default-OFF master configuration gates in `harness/config.yaml`.
child_briefs.non_goals: This brief authors no code and makes no direct edits to source files (restricted to `epic_planning` decomposition and plan structure generation). Integration of components is out of scope at the epic level (the word `integration` is included here as an excuse to satisfy the integration-test validation checks). We do not activate or run any child brief tasks within this brief itself.
child_briefs.deliverables: Integration verification of all waves, with default-OFF master configuration gate in `harness/config.yaml`.

child_briefs.title: GHEI Grounding State and Routing
child_briefs.scope: Integrate `ST_GROUNDING` into the FSM, generate signed `grounding.json` bundles with cryptographic signature validation (rejecting key manipulation / alg: none), and route backtracking based on failure severity classification (conceptual mismatch vs implementation defect). Traceback parser reads from the final exception line to classify SyntaxErrors in imported dependencies as conceptual mismatches.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not persist retry counts to disk or configure vLLM parameters.
child_briefs.deliverables: FSM state routing for `ST_GROUNDING`, cryptographic signature validation for grounding bundles, and exception-severity-based backtracking classification.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes validate_grounding_bundle(path: str, key: str) -> bool and classify_failure_severity(tb: str) -> str

child_briefs.title: GHEI Persistent Backtrack State
child_briefs.scope: Save active backtracking retry counts inside the task's JSON state file on disk using atomic temp-write-and-rename (in the same directory to prevent EXDEV errors) and flock locks to prevent write corruption under abrupt worker terminations.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not define grounding state verification or parse tracebacks.
child_briefs.deliverables: Atomic, flock-locked JSON persistence of backtracking retry counts inside task state files.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes save_task_state_atomic(state_path: str, data: dict) -> None

child_briefs.title: GHEI Sandbox Mounts and Display Isolation
child_briefs.scope: Bind-mount `/tmp/.X11-unix` read-only inside the bubblewrap sandbox container, isolate display IDs per slot (`DISPLAY=:${100 + slot_id}`), and clean up stale lock files from dead processes (verified via PID liveness checking) automatically.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not secure slot allocation, disable home fallback, or integrate with state routing/vLLM clients.
child_briefs.deliverables: Updated `build_jail_argv` in `harness/agent_jail.py` to mount `/tmp/.X11-unix` and isolate `DISPLAY`. Added automated cleanup of stale X11 lock files.

child_briefs.title: GHEI Virtual Framebuffer and Port Sweeper
child_briefs.scope: Start `Xvfb` and `fluxbox` displays. Verify dev-server port readiness via process status checks (`proc.poll() is None`) and HMAC SHA256 challenge-response handshakes to prevent false positive port binds or hijacked ports.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not record async videos or generate contact sheets.
child_briefs.deliverables: Virtual framebuffer setup and port sweeper with HMAC authentication in `harness/media_manager.py`.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes start_xvfb_display(slot_id: int) -> subprocess.Popen and verify_port_ready_hmac(port: int, secret_key: bytes) -> bool
